name: ghumo-ai
description: Ghumo AI: a group travel marketplace for independent travel organisers

scripts.setup: npm install --include=dev && npm install --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.replit: npm run setup && npm run build && npm start
